targets.recordKey: WHERE accountid = ? (2nd '?', Param_1) <- input accountid <- Sort (pass-through) <- 'Get Account to update' column accountid (account.accountid)
targets.writeCondition: One UPDATE per row of 'Get Account to update': only accounts whose computed flag differs from the stored one (WHERE temp.gen_isfundinternalagent != temp.gen_isfundinternalagentDB, DTSX:3294). Runs after Create ETL Process record (Success, DTSX:3643). Command input errorRowDisposition=FailComponent (DTSX:3397): an SQL error fails the data flow; rows already updated stay committed. NULL handling: the stored value is compared as isnull(gen_isfundinternalagent,0) AS gen_isfundinternalagentDB (DTSX:3298), so an account whose stored gen_isfundinternalagent is NULL and whose computed flag is 0 is never selected and never updated (stays NULL); NULL is replaced only when the computed flag is 1.
targets.expression: SQL 'Update accountbase set gen_isfundinternalagent = ? where accountid = ?' (DTSX:3388): 1st '?' = Param_0 <- input gen_isfundinternalagent (DT_I4). Value computed in source SQL: case when funds.gen_accountname is null then 0 else 1 end, where funds = select gen_fundmain.gen_accountname from gen_fundmain JOIN gen_agentcontract ON gen_fundmain.gen_brokernumber = gen_agentcontract.gen_agentcontractid JOIN gen_agents ON gen_agentcontract.gen_agentname = gen_agents.gen_agentsid join gen_estatecodeid on gen_estatecodeidid = gen_fundmain.gen_estatetype WHERE gen_agents.gen_agenttype = 1 and gen_estatecodeid.gen_estatetypeid not in ('0210','3') group by gen_fundmain.gen_accountname, left-joined on funds.gen_accountname = accountid. I.e. 1 if the account has at least one fund whose broker contract's agent is of type 1 and whose estate type id is not '0210'/'3', else 0. Passed unchanged through Sort (sort key accountid, EliminateDuplicates=false, DTSX:3345). Int 0/1 written into the bit column by implicit conversion.

notes.note: Business CRM writers: 2 OLE DB Commands with direct SQL on accountbase (Unsupported), 1 attribute each. The lineage script writer 'End ETL Process record\ETL Record Finish' and the script tasks Create/Error ETL Process record are ETL plumbing and are not mapped. No flat files in this package; all values come from CRM DB SQL.

Positional binding: Update Account SQL 'Update accountbase set gen_isfundinternalagent = ? where accountid = ?' -> Param_0 = gen_isfundinternalagent, Param_1 = accountid; Update accounts SQL 'Update accountbase set gen_fundwithoutagent= ? where accountid = ?' -> Param_0 = gen_isfundwithoutagent, Param_1 = accountid (component.mjs input -> ext:Param_k).

'Get Account to update' does 'select *' over three columns, but its output metadata exposes only gen_isfundinternalagent and accountid; 'Get accounts to update' exposes gen_isfundwithoutagentDB too, which passes the Sort but is not bound to the command.
Both flags are recomputed from scratch each run and can be set back to 0 (account with no qualifying fund) as well as to 1.

Whether the custom columns gen_isfundinternalagent / gen_fundwithoutagent physically exist in AccountBase (vs an extension table) depends on the CRM DB schema, which is not supplied; the DTSX only proves the SQL text.
